hook.text_role: founder admits the moment they walked away from the safe path
hook.visual: founder on camera, eye level, kitchen or garage, text card names the leap

beats.visual: founder talking head, slow push-in, warm practical light
beats.line_role: backstory in one breath: the old life and why it felt wrong

beats.visual: cutaways of the founder struggling with the old way, handheld
beats.line_role: the specific pain that started it

beats.visual: first prototype on a workbench, close-up hands
beats.line_role: what they built and why it is different

beats.visual: founder holds the product to camera, end card with offer
beats.line_role: asks the viewer in, in the founder's words; a person's last line, not a slogan: the brief's offer, else the product plus one dry line; never

audio.music: soft piano or acoustic, builds slightly
audio.voice: founder on camera, sincere, direct address

rules: roles and patterns only - no original lines, footage, audio or likeness
